motions.line: I have been waiting for this moment for too long... <> After tens of thousands of hours of effort, I finally understand now that rather than hearing things like "I need your strength", I'd rather receive your pure affections. <> Thank you. Even though I didn't say anything, you still managed to see through want I wanted. <> In that case, will you take care of the real me in between battles, for all the days to come?
